rows.replyLine: L-7 — ANSWER. A dock-owned portal teleports to <body>, so it inherits only the :root cascade. It is guaranteed the --dock-* tokens declared on :root, at their :root values (40 at the 10.0.0 tree), and none of the 45 dock-local ones (pitch/seat/run, plate tier/border, morph t, stagger, surface blur, cockpit density). For the 9 :root tokens a dock re-declares (--dock-scale, --dock-icon-glyph, --dock-control-glyph-size, --dock-label-ratio, --dock-layer-tab-size, --dock-collapsed-padding, --dock-collapsed-summary-min-size, --dock-fg-on-aurora, --dock-active-color), the portal sees the :root value, not the owning dock's. rows.replyLine: L-6 — CURE-NOW for 10.0.0, and a correction. The 2.00→0.79 ratio is stale. 0.79 was the 7.0.0 chip (8px inline, 8×1.272 block). Your 8.0.0 pin ships a uniform 8px hint pad (--overlay-pad-hint, ratio 1.00), and so do 9.0.0 and the 10.0.0 tree. That pad and the --type-caption rung are deliberate, so re-baseline against them.
